justification: Canterbury-Bankstown Ch 11.6 Potts Hill (136 live rules) and Ch 11.5 Riverlands (71) were only in the may-apply box. Their DCP site maps were fitted to the cadastre (shape IoU 0.99, lots-only IoU 0.96/0.98, placement margins 0.37/0.38, pictures checked). Both are below the fitter's 0.5 lot-line-share bar (0.449/0.439: old coarse maps, land resubdivided); the user accepted them on 2026-10-21, recorded per fit as accepted_below_bar. Loaded and keyed before merge.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A keying rule is removed or the outline ids change.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: 207 live rows unplaced, shown only in the may-apply box.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Live 2026-10-21: 62 Rowe Dr Potts Hill 136 rules, 114 Cooper Rd Birrong 0; Riverlands precinct 71, none 0.

pre_impl.existing_data: fit_site_plans.py precinct-map mode (Woollahra B1); site-plan mode limited to a 500 m window.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Sites 1.1-1.7 km across needed a site_map option; lot-line share below the bar for explained reasons (user decision).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Opt-in site_map mode, accepted_below_bar record, two outlines, two keying rules, one test.
